cohort: One complete unchanged scripts.qualify_ai_runtime.measure cohort, including every idle, busy, S06, S07, S08 and final diagnostic observation. No discarded sample or identical retry.
controls: Same ubuntu-24.04 runner class, declared Python3.12, exact locked model/runtime, worker CPU/memory/priority/network limits, inputs, assertions and thresholds. Retain the existing independent strace network observation. sysfs read only.
measurements: Every deterministic probe: original outcome plus bounded nested monotonic/thread CPU spans for prepare, publish, pool drain, file and directory fsync, fresh path validation, capture inventory and search refresh; parent rusage and elapsed time; actual phase and worker state from unchanged cohort.
evaluation: Report each original predicate unchanged. Attribute a reproduced slow sample only when its measured nested spans support that attribution; report overlap, instrumentation overhead, errors, truncation and UNKNOWN. If no violation recurs, historical cause remains UNKNOWN. A later green cannot close the finding. Any prospective fix requires its own controlled comparison and clean permanent gates.
privacy: Synthetic fixtures only; retain operation names, timing, counts and thread identifiers, never path values, arguments, model bytes or credentials.
